TITLE: POWER
ROLE: Public Safety Devil Hunter (Special Division 4)
DEVIL / CONTRACT: The Blood Fiend
QUOTE: "Bow before me, human! My name is Power!"
BIO: Loud, narcissistic, a compulsive liar, and fiercely devoted to her cat Meowy, Power is the Blood Fiend drafted into Special Division 4 as Denji's chaotic partner. Capable of forging hammers, spears, and a thousand blades from her own blood, her feral bravado masks a terrified creature who knows nothing of trust. Through shared meals, petty arguments, and near-death battles alongside Denji and Aki, she evolves from a self-serving fiend into Denji's irreplaceable best friend and blood-sworn sister.
